## Install

- **Windows:** run the `.exe` installer (or the `.msi`).
- **Linux:** `.deb` (Debian/Ubuntu), `.rpm` (Fedora) or the portable `.AppImage`.
- **Android:** install the `.apk` (allow installs from this source when asked).
- **Updates:** the apps check for new versions and update themselves. The server updates from its dashboard (Update and restart).
- **ZimaOS / server:** install the Zima Connect app from `server/zimaos-app.yml`, or run
  `ghcr.io/OWNER/zima-connect-server:latest`. Open `http://<server>:9121`
  and use the setup code to join your first device.

The desktop installers are not code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen may warn on first run.
